`PLAN.md` is written with the three required headings in order. No commits made.

**The schedule:** 2026-08-24 → 2026-11-02, 48 business days. Kickoff is 5 business days out.

All eight milestones chain contiguously, so the 48-day total equals the sum of the durations exactly — there's no slack in the plan, and every holiday just stretches its milestone by a calendar day. All three company holidays fall inside the window (8/31 in requirements, 9/25 in build-core, 10/12 in build-integrations).

Two things I flagged in Notes that you may want to act on:

- **`holidays.csv` may be incomplete.** It lists only three company holidays. Monday **2026-09-07 is US Labor Day** and is currently scheduled as a working day — and it happens to be the end date of `requirements`. If the org observes it, adding it (and any other public holidays) shifts every subsequent date out by a day or more. I scheduled it as a working day because the conventions say to exclude exactly the dates in the file, but this is the most likely input error.
- **`launch` straddles a weekend**, starting Fri 10/30 and ending Mon 11/2. Correct per the rules, but if you want launch in one contiguous stretch it should start the following Monday.
